title: kith-chat/tests: BlobStore initialized on /tmp directly without init(), no TempDir guard
description: integration.rs:31: BlobStore::new(std::env::temp_dir()) uses /tmp itself as base_dir (not a subdirectory), and init() is never called. If any test sends attachments, blob files land directly in /tmp. Parallel tests could collide on blob IDs. Fix: use tempfile::TempDir to create an isolated subdirectory and call .init() before passing to the dispatcher, matching the pattern used in e2e.rs.
